annotations.title: Player Props Research, Model & Cheat Sheet

description: Use this when the user asks about a player's prop lines, how often he clears a line, or today's prop board. Returns, for a player_id, one compact row per stat with a line for his next game: the consensus line and book count, his last five games against it and his season average; signed in, the last ten and his record against the closing line; with Keel Stats Pro also L20 and season hit rates, the opening line and move, the model's probability against the market's, the best price at the books and the matchup, and with `detail` the book-by-book odds, closing lines, game log, history and alternate ladders. Without a player_id, today's prop board (Pro: model edge and the daily cheat sheet). The answer's `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Not for picks: it is research only and never gives a pick.

date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the NBA daily prop board.

detail.description: With a player_id (Keel Stats Pro): "compact" (default), "full" (every section, the long answer), or a comma-separated list of sections: "books" (book-by-book odds and history), "ladders" (alternate lines graded), "closes" (closing lines per game), "games" (the game log with closes), "history" (record against the close by season).

game_id.description: Optional numeric game ID to filter the daily prop board to a single game.

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID to inspect his lines for the next game. Omit for the daily prop board.

stat.description: Optional stat code: narrows a player's rows and sections, or picks the board's stat (e.g. NBA: "pts", "reb", "ast", "tpm", "pra"; NFL: "passing_yards", "rushing_yards", "receiving_yards", "receptions").
